subject: Qtr Ignite: OKR allocation & exec fast-track
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Qtr Ignite: OKR allocation & exec fast-track

Team —

Attaching the first pass of the "Qtr Ignite" OKR slate for Q4 planning (draft attached). Primary ask: please confirm owners, success metrics, and any hard constraints by EOD Wednesday so we can fast-track to an exec sign-off slot on Thursday. High-level notes: 

- Objective A (Performance & Cost): tighten latency target for hosted paths; proposed metric: p95 <= 180ms, target 12% cost reduction vs baseline. Owner: Marissa (please confirm).
- Objective B (Reliability): increase dedup cache hit to 40% for repetitive workloads; tentative owner: Jonas.
- Objective C (Platform Velocity): reduce model rollout time by 30% (measured from model upload to serving). Owner: Karthik — need roadmap alignment.

Risks I want flagged up front: any large capacity changes required to meet Objective A (Marissa) and any security dependencies for Objective C (Karthik). If we can resolve those quickly we can present a short QBR narrative (one slide per objective) alongside the OKR packet.

Attachments: Q3_ignite_OKRs_v1.pdf (draft), plus a short slide with proposed exec talking points in the Drive link below.

Next steps: owners respond with confirmations or redlines by EOD Wed. If we get clean confirmations we run a 30-min exec fast-track on Thu 9:00am PT.

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Product Officer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q3_ignite_OKRs_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]
[Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C_OKR_RUNBOOK]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qtr Ignite: OKR allocation & exec fast-track

Vivek — thanks for the clear framing. Quick responses inline: 

- Objective A: I can take point, but the p95 <= 180ms is aggressive for the multi-tenant hosted lanes without a short-term cache burn. Recommend phasing: 180ms target for dedicated/dx lanes, 200ms for hosted with plan to converge by EOY.
- Capacity impact: see attached capacity-estimates.xlsx — we show a potential +22% GPU-hours for the first 6 weeks if we push aggressive kernel selection and fewer quantization fallbacks.
- Objective C: agree with Karthik owning velocity; we need to lock down the security gating (SDK certificaiton) before rollout.

I copied Emily (Acme) because their QBR is a good narrative to highlight the hosting improvements — Emily, quick FYI: if we land the phased latency plan, your team should see the multi-tenant improvement in their next week of trials.

If no objections, I will update the objective phrasing and re-submit a v1.1 with adjusted targets by tomorrow EOD.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Platform Product
[Attachment: capacity-estimates.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qtr Ignite: OKR allocation & exec fast-track

+1 on the phased latency proposal. A couple of clarifications from the reliability side: 

- The 40% dedup cache hit looks achievable, but we should split that metric into prefix-hit vs. KV-hit so we can correlate to the latency improvements. Suggest: prefix hit >= 22% and KV-hit >= 18%.
- For the QBR narrative, I want a single failure-mode story: show a regression, the rollback path, and the guardrails we put in place (metrics, alerting, fallback model). That's what execs care about.

Vivek — if we keep the objectives crisp and give the exec a real rollback example, I can support fast-track sign-off. Marissa, if your capacity numbers hold, we should show the impact on unit economics (tokens per GPU-hour) on the slide.

Short note — I will: 

- Update the rollout roadmap to reflect the security gating and add the SDK certification milestone (ETA 9/10).
- Change Objective C metric to: "time-to-serve (median/90) reduced by 30% for staged models" so it's measurable.
- Push an updated packet (v1.2) to Drive and ping Vivek + Marissa by 10:00am PT Tue (8/17).

One-liner: +1 to fast-track if we can show a concrete rollback example.

—Karthik

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qtr Ignite: OKR allocation & exec fast-track — exec packet approved

Thanks all — quick update: 

- Reviewed Marissa's capacity estimates and Jonas's metric split; the team agrees on the phased latency approach and the split cache metrics.
- Karthik's change to the Objective C metric works for exec clarity.
- I've incorporated the rollback narrative and the unit-econ slide. Final packet attached.

We are on for a 30-minute exec fast-track tomorrow Thu 9:00am PT. Laura — can you book the slot and add the QBR deck to the exec calendar invite? Marissa, please include the capacity slide and an ask for a 6-week burst allocation in the deck.

Cc'ing Emily so Acme has visibility to the narrative we'll present in their QBR next month.

Final: Q3_ignite_OKRs_final.pdf attached.

Vivek
